Entries.Text: Dummies
Dummies

Select dummies by reference ID, and change the IDs of many at once. Reference IDs are what TAE events, params and effects use to find a dummy. In Contents, type ref: and IDs (ref:200-299) in the filter to list those dummies.
Load a model to work on its dummies.
This model has no dummies.
Reference IDs and ranges, separated by commas: 220, or 200-299, or 100, 120, 300-310.
Select by Reference ID
Selects the dummies whose reference IDs are listed, or that share an ID with the selected dummies.
Select Matching ({0})
Selects every dummy with one of the IDs typed above, in place of the current selection.
Select All With the Selected IDs
Selects every dummy sharing a reference ID with a selected dummy, such as all the points of one hitbox or effect.
Change Reference IDs
Adds an amount to, or sets, the reference IDs of the selected dummies or of those with the listed IDs. One undo step.
Selected dummies ({0})
Changes the dummies selected in Contents or the viewport.
Dummies with these IDs
Changes every dummy whose reference ID is listed below.
Offset by
Adds the amount to each ID: 200-210 offset by 100 become 300-310.
Set to
Gives every dummy the same ID.
The amount added to each ID. Negative to subtract.
The ID every dummy gets.
No dummies to change: select some, or type IDs.
{0} of {1} dummies change: {2}
{0} IDs would fall outside -32768 to 32767, so nothing can be applied.
{0} of the new IDs are already used by other dummies. That is how the games group points, so it may be intended.
Apply ({0})
Changes the IDs as previewed. Can be undone as one step.
{0} IDs
Select All With Ref ID {0}
Selects every dummy with this reference ID (or the selected dummies' IDs).
Change Reference IDs...
Opens Tools > Dummies to offset or set the selected dummies' reference IDs.
Change the reference IDs of {0} dummies
Labels on Selection Only
Draws dummy and bone labels only for the selected dummies and bones, as a character has hundreds. Turn the labels on above.
